description: Every narration claim traces to one entry here. An entry with status 'unverified' must NOT appear in the narration as fact — delete it or rephrase it as a question/rumour, labelled as such. Written by the researcher (agent), validated by pipeline/run.py --stage research.

claim.description: The assertion, in the source's own terms — what it measures, exact numbers, no paraphrase drift

date.description: Date the claim refers to (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM); 'undated' only if the source gives none

narration_text.description: Required when status is 'rephrased': the exact wording the narration uses

status.description: verified: the source states it directly. unverified: could not be confirmed — excluded from the narration. rephrased: the narration states a weaker, sourced version — see 'narration_text'

source_date.description: Publication date of the source (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

source_url.description: The public Roblox URL the video is built from

title: claims.json — verified claims for one ROBLOX VIDEO FACTORY video
